text:
deploybot: Release request queued by @alex for v2.14.3-hotfix. Target: staging -> canary -> prod. Change window: immediate (out-of-hours).

alex: Need expedited approval. This fixes a binary serializer crash causing intermittent 500s on embeddings. Minimal surface.

maria: @alex what is the exact image/tag we are pinning? Need release notes link for CS handoff.

alex: Pin: `gcr.io/redwood/inference:v2.14.3-hotfix-20260322`. Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/v2.14.3-hotfix (WIP).

sam_ops: Ops checklist: Healthchecks passing on staging? Telemetry ingestion stable? Any memory/regressions in prior deploys?

alex: Staging smoke ran 10m ago, no errors in logs for the serializer path. Perf within baseline. Telemetry shows normal token throughput.

jin: Can we run a quick canary with 5% traffic to eu-west1 first? If metric delta < 2% and error rate < 0.1%, we promote.

noah: There's a queued backfill job hitting the same service; recommend draining backfill to avoid noisy signals.

alex: Good catch — paused backfill 2m ago.

deploybot: Canaries created: canary-20260322-1 (5% eu-west1). Monitor window: 10m. Auto-rollback on error rate > 0.5% or p50 latency > 200ms.

maria: Docs: I'll finish release notes and CS blurb. Please include rollback instructions and impact messaging.

sam_ops: Need explicit rollback criteria in thread: if embeddings 5xx count > 10 in 10m or any spike in memory OOMs -> rollback. Also require ops ack to proceed.

alex: Rollback plan: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=stable-v2.14.2` + pin traffic back via routing policy. Adding to release notes.

jin: Observability hooks: enable `trace=hotfix-20260322` and keep logs at debug for canary group only. Set alerts to paging for ops-oncall if X-Rate exceeds threshold.

noah: ops ack: :thumbsup: I've got oncall coverage and will watch metrics.

sam_ops: ops ack: LGTM from infra. Approving expedited canary.

maria: marketing/CS note done and linked in release doc. Small paragraph about regression fix and mitigation steps.

alex: Kicking canary now. Command used:
```
./releasectl deploy --image gcr.io/redwood/inference:v2.14.3-hotfix-20260322 --target canary --traffic 5% --tag hotfix-20260322
```

deploybot: Canary started. Link: https://deploy.redwood.com/canaries/canary-20260322-1.

jin: Monitoring 10m window. Will post results.

(7m later)

jin: Canary metrics look clean: errors 0, p50 latency +1%. Memory unchanged. No OOMs.

noah: Observability: traces show serializer path resolved. No anomalous spans.

sam_ops: Given metrics, approve staged rollout to 25% for 15m. Keep same rollback triggers.

alex: Rolling to 25%.

deploybot: Traffic updated to 25%.

(15m later)

jin: 25% steady. Errors 2 (below threshold), p50 +2.5%. No OOMs.

maria: CS notified. Release notes published.

sam_ops: Final ops signoff for prod: :white_check_mark:. We can promote to prod during the change window.

alex: Promoting to prod now. Tagging build and creating release artifact.

deploybot: Production rollout started. Staged increments: 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m bake each step. Auto-rollback still enabled.

(no incidents)

alex: All done. Prod at 100%, metrics stable. Thanks all. Will follow up with post-deploy checklist items in release doc. :tada:
